title: How to match a sock you still own
standfirst: One sock is left. This is how to choose its replacement.
body:
The drawer has one sock in it. The other has gone where socks go. Before you order a replacement, there are three things to check, in this order.

## Weight

The Spare Sock comes in two. Everyday is combed cotton, 80% cotton, 17% recycled polyamide and 3% elastane. Heavyweight is a merino blend, 60% merino wool, 20% cotton, 17% recycled polyamide and 3% elastane.

The quickest test is to hold the sock you have up against a window. If you can see the light through the leg, it is Everyday. If it looks like a small sleeve, it is Heavyweight. If you cannot tell, look at the label. If there is no label, it has been through some things, and Everyday is the safer choice.

## Size

Foot length: S 220 mm, M 250 mm, L 280 mm, XL 310 mm. These correspond to UK 3 to 5, 6 to 8, 9 to 11 and 12 to 14. Lay the sock flat and measure it from heel to toe. Socks that have shrunk are the wrong guide, so measure your foot if the sock has had a long life.

The cuff is 100 mm, crew height. If your sock is taller or shorter, we do not match it. We sell the one height.

## Colour, and how it fades

New black is not the black of a sock that has been through 40 washes. Black fades to a softer, greyer colour. The change is slow and no one notices until the two socks are next to each other.

That is why Nearly Black exists. It is for a black sock that has been washed 40 times.¹ It is not for a navy sock, and it is not for a sock that was always grey. For those there is Navy, Grey Marl and Oat.

Hold your remaining sock in daylight, beside the swatch on the product page, or beside a sock of the target colour in the shop. Artificial light flatters everything.

## Washing, for next time

30°C, inside out. Heat and friction are what fade a sock, and the instruction to wash at 30 is not decoration.

## One more thing

A single sock arrives on a hanger card, and cannot be returned once worn. If you are not sure about the colour, leave the card on the hanger until you have held the two together in daylight.

If you buy two, you will have a pair. We will not point this out.²

Sock Clips, a set of six for £5, will keep the next two together. They are not a guarantee. Nothing is.
footnotes: Forty is not a laboratory figure. It is the point at which most people stop pretending that the sock is still black.

title: What counts as an emergency, for sandwich purposes
body:
The Emergency Sandwich is made for the moment lunch has failed. This invites a question, which is how failed lunch has to be before the sandwich is warranted. We have thought about it.

## What counts

Lunch is missing. It was meant to be in the bag and is on the kitchen counter, ten miles away.

Lunch is present and unusable. It has been under a laptop. It has been sat on.

Lunch was a plan, and the plan has gone. A meeting has overrun, a shop is shut, and it is now the afternoon.

In each case, a person is hungry and there is no sandwich. That is the whole definition.

## What does not count

A sandwich you do not fancy. A sandwich that is fine. A craving, however sincere. Being a little bit peckish at 11.15.

We do not check. Anyone can open the case. But the idea only works if the emergency is real, and we would like it to stay that way.

## How it is made

To order, at our workshop. Sliced loaf, two triangles per sandwich, sealed in a rigid red PET case, about 230 g, 160 by 110 by 60 mm. The case protects it from bags, desks and other people.

The fillings are Cheddar and Pickle, Ham and Mustard, Egg and Cress, and Plain Buttered. Plain Buttered is for the days when the emergency is also a bad one.

## Timing

Use within 48 hours of dispatch, printed on the lid. Keep it refrigerated at 5°C or below. It goes by chilled next-day delivery, dispatched Monday to Thursday, or you can collect it from our workshop. There is no other way, because a sandwich that spends three days in a van is a different emergency.¹

This means the sandwich is for an emergency you have seen coming by at least a day. We have noticed this. It is a limitation of sandwiches.

## What is not covered

The sandwich is not covered by the warranty. It is food.² If it arrives spoiled, report it within 24 hours of delivery with a photo, and we will resend it or refund it, whichever you prefer.
footnotes: The emergency is the planning. The sandwich is the consequence.
This is a policy and also a point of principle.
